thig3.6:1.1: kiṃ me katā Rājagahe manussā madhuṃ pītā va acchare | ye Sukkaṃ na upāsanti desentiṃ buddhasāsanaṃ. || ||
thig3.6:2.1: tañ ca appaṭivāniyaṃ asecanakam ojavaṃ | pivanti maññe sappaññā valāhakam iv' addhagū. || ||
thig3.6:3.1: sukkā sukkehi dhammehi vītarāgā samāhitā | dhārehi antimaṃ dehaṃ jetvā Māraṃ savāhanaṃ. || || Sukkā. ||
